name: Ahira
overview: Ahira, identified as the son of Enan, served as the captain or prince of the tribe of Naphtali during the wilderness period of Israel's journey. Scripture highlights his leadership role by naming him specifically as the tribal captain in Numbers 1:15 and 2:29. Additionally, Ahira's role included presenting offerings on behalf of his tribe, as detailed in Numbers 7:78-81, where he brought a carefully measured and significant offering of silver, gold, and animals, reflecting his responsibility in leading Naphtali in worship and dedication to God.
